decisions.reason: As a newly launched but portfolio-fitting Christmas gift item, the electronic music box would usually be given at least another season, though its electronic element makes it a somewhat riskier niche for a traditional wood-products firm.
A wooden nativity stable is a classic, low-risk extension of a German seasonal wooden crafts range and would normally stay unless early demand was clearly weak.

The modern incense smoker figurine broadens the firm's traditional decorative range toward newer tastes, so management would likely keep it for further testing despite some style-related market uncertainty.
